title: CreateRestrictedDataTokenResponse
description: The response schema for the createRestrictedDataToken operation.

restrictedDataToken.description: A Restricted Data Token (RDT). This is a short-lived access token that authorizes calls to restricted operations. Pass this value with the x-amz-access-token header when making subsequent calls to these restricted resources.

expiresIn.description: The lifetime of the Restricted Data Token, in seconds.
